criteria.text: A1 fork trusted stamp: StepFinishPart optional `served` exactly `{modelID, responseID?, requestModelID?}` matching frozen api_server contract. finish-step uses provider response model/id; SDK-generated aitxt ids omitted; fallback model is wire `model.api.id`; strings bounded 256. Client `updatePart` cannot forge/replace/remove stored served; absent stays absent. History returns served. Retry success records successful attempt.

A2 dispatch writes: wire existing repository into prompt/promptAsync non-fatally; pending before SDK, accepted/rejected after, no-op rejected. Add optional server-owned provenance. Resolution wrapper retains old API while adding source/requested tier/routeAuthed. Real callers provide trusted origins; WS cannot forge origin. Fallback rows link predecessor. User message.updated links oldest matching non-rejected row within 60s idempotently. Projection adds deterministic dispatches while existing keys remain compatible; Postgres local_only behavior remains.
A3 tests: fork served tests; focused API b1/projection/new dispatch/resolver/redispatch/parity tests; fork typecheck/build; API typecheck/build.

A4 live sandbox: after rebuild/restart, use real OpenRouter probe/session to prove routed alias gets concrete served model + gen id and projection links dispatch. Also prove forged served PATCH cannot alter it, restart durability, and nonexistent model produces no fabricated served identity. Run fallback/budget cases only with safe synthetic config/knobs; precondition unmet is explicit, not PASS. Cleanup disposable sessions/rows.

A5 evidence: contract maps every criterion; run note exact commands/results, no secrets. Existing slim Inspector may remain; do not add dispatch-history UI. Real-provider probe is authorized but no other provider credential use.
